description: Search GPU machines that can be rented now on AmpleRun. gpu_model, gpu_count and max_rate_micro_per_hour filter on the server. min_vram_gib and region filter each fetched page here because the API has no such filters, so a page can return fewer than limit matches: scanned is how many offers were checked, and next_cursor continues. Prices are micro-units per hour for the whole machine, fee included; cheapest first. With template, each offer carries fit {fits, reason}. Read-only; no API key needed.

gpu_count.description: Minimum number of GPUs in the machine.

gpu_model.description: Case-insensitive part of the GPU model name, e.g. "4090" or "A100".

max_rate_micro_per_hour.description: Highest machine price per hour in micro-units, e.g. "500000" for 0.50 USDC/h.

min_vram_gib.description: Minimum VRAM per GPU in GiB. Offers with unmeasured VRAM are excluded.

region.description: Case-insensitive part of the host's cloud region, e.g. "us-east". Offers without a reported region are excluded.

template.description: Template slug such as "pytorch-cuda", or its id (UUID), from list_templates.

name: search_offers
title: Search GPU offers
